digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI/CD workflow and documentation gate routing
propositions: Documentation-only changes currently consume the full OS/Python matrix plus mutation, packaging, optionality, identity, eval, and golden-path jobs instead of a reduced documentation-validation lane.

A trusted classifier executing only from origin/main with fail-closed semantics must route documentation-only patchsets to a reduced lane that skips build/test matrix jobs while retaining documentation gates (ADR validation, index/cross-reference, quickstart, drift checks).

The classifier must check only the exact patchset diff (HEAD^..HEAD) as untrusted data; classifier logic and allowlist execute from trusted origin/main with credentials disabled and must never import or execute patchset-controlled code.

A single extracted composite action `.github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml` must replace copied inline documentation gate commands in both full and docs-only routes, and all structural consumers (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py, etc.) must follow the extracted definition.

Classifier job failure must run full-route fallback jobs via always()+result gating, prevent docs-only execution, and still block Verified; classifier success plus route=docs-only is required for docs-only job execution.

Production proof must demonstrate that a genuine documentation-only change reduces wall-clock time and runner-minutes versus baseline, and a genuine non-documentation change still executes the complete full-route test suite.
